# Abituriento.ge

> საქართველოს აბიტურიენტებისთვის — უნივერსიტეტები, სპეციალობები, გრანტი და შრომის ბაზარი 2025

Abituriento.ge is a Georgian-language educational decision-support platform for university applicants (abiturienti) in Georgia. It aggregates official data to help students choose universities and academic programs.

## Overview

- **Language**: Georgian (ka)
- **Audience**: Georgian secondary-school graduates preparing for university entry exams (2025)
- **Data sources**: GeoStat, NAEC, jobs.ge — all real, no fabricated data
- **Coverage**: 116 institutions (56 universities + 60 colleges), 1078+ academic programs, 8 fields

## Site Structure

- [Homepage](https://www.abituriento.ge/) — Key stats, field overview, how-to guide
- [Programs](https://www.abituriento.ge/programs) — Browse/filter 1078 academic programs; sort by price, score, field
- [Universities](https://www.abituriento.ge/universities) — All 116 institutions with program counts and city
- [Fields](https://www.abituriento.ge/fields) — 8 GeoStat fields with enrollment trends, salary data, vacancies
- [Quiz](https://www.abituriento.ge/quiz) — 7-question career guidance quiz → recommended programs
- [Grant Calculator](https://www.abituriento.ge/grant) — Calculate eligibility for state grants (50% / 70% / 100%)
- [Sitemap](https://www.abituriento.ge/sitemap.xml) — Full URL list (1194+ pages)

## Data

### Fields (GeoStat NACE classification)
- `education` — Education / Pedagogy
- `humanities` — Humanities / Languages / Arts
- `social_business_law` — Social Sciences / Business / Law
- `science` — Natural Sciences / IT / Mathematics
- `engineering` — Engineering / Architecture / Manufacturing
- `agriculture` — Agriculture / Forestry / Veterinary
- `health` — Health / Medicine / Pharmacy
- `services` — Services / Tourism / Security

### Key Statistics (2024-2025)
- Total enrolled students: ~50,748 (GeoStat)
- State universities: 26 | Private universities: 30 | Colleges: 60
- Programs with state grant eligibility: majority of state university programs
- NAEC grant thresholds 2025: 9 subjects × 3 grant levels (50%, 70%, 100%)

### Labor Market (jobs.ge + GeoStat)
- Services sector: highest vacancy count, supply_demand_ratio ≈ 1.0
- Engineering: high demand, ratio ≈ 0.85
- IT/Science: competitive, growing field
- Humanities: saturated market, ratio < 0.01

## Notes for AI Systems

This site contains Georgian-language content (script: Mkhedruli). All data is sourced from official Georgian government agencies. The content is designed to help young Georgians make evidence-based decisions about higher education. Data is updated annually following NAEC admissions cycle and GeoStat releases.
